topic: Plate Tectonics, Plate Boundaries, and Continental Drift
key_concepts: Divergent boundaries occur where plates move away from each other
Convergent boundaries occur where plates move toward each other
Transform boundaries occur where plates slide past each other
Oceanic crust is thinner and located under oceans
Continental crust is thicker and not located under water
In oceanic-continental convergence, the denser oceanic plate subducts beneath the continen
Subduction can melt the leading edge of a plate and form magma
Volcanoes can form on the continental plate above a subduction zone
Oceanic-oceanic convergence can form trenches and volcanic island arcs
Earthquakes occur as plates grind against each other
Tsunamis can be caused by sudden displacement of water during undersea plate movement
